observations: Photo 0 shows the retail packaging for an itel PowerPulse Series power bank.
The brand 'itel' and model 'A1490' are clearly printed on the box.
The box specifies a capacity of 40,000mAh and a power output of 22.5W.
The packaging lists 6 ports (4 USB-A and 2 Type-C) and support for PD3.0 and QC3.0 fast charging.
A 12-month warranty sticker is visible on the front of the box.
The actual power bank is not visible in the photo; only the box is shown.

claims.claim: Never run out of battery again
claims.evidence: This is a subjective marketing statement dependent on user behavior.

risks.proof: A photo of the actual power bank outside of the packaging.

risks.risk: The device may be non-functional or have a degraded battery.
risks.proof: A video showing the device charging a phone and its own LED display active.
